common.geometry: NEW named adoption of continuous occupied-body/interior geometry only for these five spells: finite actual world coordinates,body poses and complete authored volumes. Mere exterior tangency is not sphere/cone exposure; actual opaque total cover blocks LoE. Defined center-to-anchor control ranges are Euclidean lengths; they do not rewrite general grid movement. Actual movement pays the source scene current movement metric/terrain cost and physical path; image displacement is its explicit separate source operation. Missing geometry,body pose,route,support or material facts hold the whole dependent branch. A private apparent coordinate is never an actual effect origin or physical body.
common.time: Record application time/sequence,original regular START/END markers and actual6second opportunities. Expiry wins at equality before new effects. Preserve original clocks through initiative changes,absence,extra turns and controller changes; no new resource or Action at a spell-only bookkeeping checkpoint. Regular START refresh/recharge/recovery/death saves precede other start effects and voluntary decisions. Actual Unconscious still has its regular death saves when truly Dying. An ending save allowed below is not an Action,Reaction,death save,recharge or companion turn.
common.information: Keep world truth,actual body/action/life state,recipient-private sensory view,observer knowledge and cast-private admission/RNG records separately. The caster gains no hidden roster,save result,HP,enemy predicate,source defense or blocked-query reason. Do not publish seeds,hidden d20s or payload dice unless an exact source presentation grant applies. Ordinary witness facts remain actual evidence; recognition never shares itself telepathically. No source provides a camera,omniscient map or truth-debug interface.
common.apparentCandidate: NEW P156-APPARENT-01 applies ONLY to an unrecognized apparent creature/object presented by this Mass Hallucination or Illusory Dragon. A genuinely deceived actor may declare an otherwise legally available creature/object-targeted Action,spell or ordinary attack at that apparent coordinate. Verify observable prerequisites and actual available cost/Action/components first; commit normal costs/cadence,then actual interruption windows. Before any target attack/save/effect roll,revalidate the real required target and its actual position/range/LoE. Missing/shifted ineligible body gives no target roll/effect and no special reason,identity or replacement target; costs remain. This is an expressly new paid apparent-candidate failure,not legal creature/object status for an image. It adds NO Spectral Army AC10,attack-roll/detonation permission,opportunity-attack trigger or on-hit/kill benefit. Recognized false images have no apparent-candidate permission and known invalid requests cost0. Real physical inspection/touch/movement retains its own Action/interactions,cost and geometry; actual weapon/projectile collision consequences need their own sources and stay held if absent.
common.defenses: Use actual condition/source scope. This return explicitly classifies Hall private visual remapping,Phantom private dying belief/mental Unconscious,and Anti compelled approach/retreat as mind-affecting spell components for the exact accepted Mind Blank Abjuration rule. Dragon fear is imposed emotion; its psychic packets use actual psychic immunity independently. The external Dragon sensory image is not a recipient mental rewrite and remains an apparent world image under Mind Blank. Charmed-only immunity grants no immunity to these uncharmed spells; fear-only immunity affects Dragon fear only. Broader actually applicable protections are checked before fresh establishment; existing covered components suspend with original clocks/guards. No prevented component appears after immunity ends. No new unavailable Mind Blank school access is granted.
common.lifeAndCustody: Only genuine damage changes real HP,tempHP,Wounds,Injuries,concentration or death ledgers. Apply exact ordinary/Null recipient lifecycle and original root flags; caster-paid Dragon breath roots belong to caster,not image/target. Preserve physical items,owners,custody,charges,damage,real dropped objects,spent actions and counters through recognition/suppression/ending. Real0 causes its own Unconscious,real death persists. Ending a perception effect neither heals nor resurrects nor resets a death save. No fake corpse,XP,loot,RP,kill or healing event follows illusory0 or image removal.
common.holds: All inherited source/content/access/physical/lifecycle/knowledge/runtime/human-play/balance/cosmology/release holds remain. Actual faction/hostility/creature taxonomy/identities,geometry/equipment/weapon sources and missing private information are facts to prove,not authored successes. Synthetic fixtures show conditional deterministic specifications,not actual campaign examples or an executed game. No supplied/historical programs are executed.

rules.image: NEW one visual/audible dragon image in a20ft cube centered at a declared perceived anchor within120ft/LoE. A known generic dragon-shaped figure and a repeated nonlinguistic roar are appearance only,not actual dragon taxonomy,memories,messages or a statblock. Creation volume must be clear of actual solid matter and real bodies; no support is needed for a nonphysical image. It has no creature/object HP,AC,body,inventory,collision,cover,transport capacity,senses,independent turn or companion budget. Physical inspection can prove it false personally without destroying it. P156-APPARENT-01 grants only the new paid hidden-failure pathway; there is no Spectral Army attack/detonation rule.
rules.movement: NEW on an actual caster regular turn,spend one real Bonus Action to translate the image at most30ft along one declared3D route,with complete swept image volume clear of actual opaque solid matter and ending within120ft of the caster. Visual flight is not real flight/support. Passing through a real creature is nonphysical and supplies actual contradiction only to an observer who perceives that contact; it creates no damage or new fear admission. Known invalid movement rejects before BA; hidden obstruction stops at last legal image position,spends BA and grants no secret diagnostic/free remaining move. The image provides no scouting report. Caster moving beyond120ft or losing source-to-image LoE makes move/breath unavailable until legally restored; image persists at last position until source ends. No teleport of image on reacquisition.
rules.fear: NEW one finite initial audience: all real creatures,friend or foe,within30ft of the established image anchor by occupied-body interior,with actual LoE and usable sight perceiving the image at that instant. Each independently saves WIS versus original caster DC. Failure establishes image-sourced Frightened unless actual applicable fear/mental defense prevents it. No admission on later sight,entry,movement or resumption. Source-local operating gate: its Frightened expression is suspended while image is suppressed or not actually visually perceived by that recipient,so hidden image movement cannot become a location oracle. While operative use exact Frightened: disadvantage attacks/checks while source visible,and cannot willingly approach its current anchor. No forced flight,dropped items or lost full Action. Repeat WIS at every future actual regular END,including while temporarily unseen/suppressed; first success ends that record. Initial success protects only against this cast. Death/expiry/removal ends it. NEW for an owner-attached recipient,only the original real attached END may host the same save; if none exists,a six-second save-only checkpoint supplies it,never movement,Action,Reaction,recharge or death save. Exact original deadline never extends.
rules.breath: NEW after establishment,on a real caster regular turn spend one actual Action,at most once per original numbered-round opportunity,to emit a30ft right-circular cone with45degree half-angle from one declared mouth point on/in the image cube and one declared axis. Caster must actually perceive/locate its own image,be within120ft and have source-to-image LoE; each target needs actual mouth LoE and occupied-body INTERIOR intersection. All real creatures including allies/caster are eligible; no object damage or image target. Each makes WIS versus original spell DC; fail6d6psychic,success floor(shared6d6/2),then actual defenses. One shared6d6 is generated for each genuinely manifested activation,including an empty cone,as a NEW private data operation; no cast/RP/cadence/caster-hook duplication. No initial free breath—the creation Action is already spent. No breath while suppressed,source-ended or budget spent,no stored discharge after resumption. No generic elemental breath,ignition,normal-weapon hit or corpse effect.
rules.independentComponents: NEW psychic damage and failed-save fear are magical functions independent of believing the image. True Seeing or conclusive examination marks the image as personally identifiable false presentation; neither is antimagic,psychic immunity or a free fear success. Blind recipients are not initially admitted to visual fear but can be actual cone recipients. Fear-only immunity does not block psychic damage; psychic-only immunity does not remove an independently eligible fear relation. Exact Mind Blank classification follows common.defenses. No borrowed dragon defenses or ordinary creature restoration applies to an image.
rules.rootsAndEnding: NEW every actual paid breath activation consumes its Action/round opportunity before callbacks and makes a distinct caster-owned damage root for each actual recipient,all using that caster current unsuppressed Null state at creation. One shared pool is not one shared recipient root; pure transfer retains its root,never duplicate funding. Later activation re-evaluates then-current caster state. Image is not a dealer. One image per caster,concentration60elapsed seconds. Source ending erases image/fear/remaining activation permission without final breath. Suppression suspends presentation,movement,damage and operative fear while original ending-save/deadline bookkeeping continues. Restoring it gives no replay,free Action or new fear audience.

common.casting: All five: actual Wizard rank8, minimum Wizard15, base21RP, Action,V/S/F. Mass Hallucination range30ft; other preserved Core ranges120ft. NEW Glibness is self-only as printed YOU; preserve120ft as conflicting source metadata, not ally targeting. Antipathy has both printed Enchantment/Illusion placements but only actual Enchantment class access; no alternate acquisition or mode switch. Actual legal book,prepared matrix,Action,usable V/S/F,perception,range,LoE and source target are required. Known invalid attempts reject before cost; hidden actual failure after lawful commitment has no refund or diagnostic. No generic upcast or level scaling.
common.payment: Use exact ordinary casting. Read D before cast: limit=max(4,2+PB+max(0,castingModifier)); ranked surcharges+1/+2/+3 at limit/limit+3/limit+6; ordinary ranked casting blocked at limit+6. Rank6–9 baseD2,rank1–5 baseD1,rank0baseD0; consecutive same family Refrain1/2/3cap3; another family resets, idle/weapon turns do not. Actual Wizard first distinct prepared family waives baseD only. Pay costs and Action,update cadence once,establish any required concentration ending old incompatible concentration,then allow actual counters. Failed/saved/countered casts do not refund or restore old concentration. Native later image movement/breath,examination,rousing and compelled movement are not new casts.
common.ready: Choose spell and fixed mode/program/filter policy at actual paid preparation; all held spells require concentration. Counter window is preparation only. Choose/revalidate target/locus at release through actual Reaction after a perceivable trigger; no second spell cost/cadence/counter. Invalid occurrence may wait until next own regular START; expired/replaced hold has no refund. Effect clock starts at manifestation. A concentration spell continues the held slot; Glibness releases it after manifestation. Release outside own turn supplies no free later breath/companion Action.
common.geometry: NEW named adoption of continuous occupied-body/interior geometry only for these five spells: finite actual world coordinates,body poses and complete authored volumes. Mere exterior tangency is not sphere/cone exposure; actual opaque total cover blocks LoE. Defined center-to-anchor control ranges are Euclidean lengths; they do not rewrite general grid movement. Actual movement pays the source scene current movement metric/terrain cost and physical path; image displacement is its explicit separate source operation. Missing geometry,body pose,route,support or material facts hold the whole dependent branch. A private apparent coordinate is never an actual effect origin or physical body.
common.time: Record application time/sequence,original regular START/END markers and actual6second opportunities. Expiry wins at equality before new effects. Preserve original clocks through initiative changes,absence,extra turns and controller changes; no new resource or Action at a spell-only bookkeeping checkpoint. Regular START refresh/recharge/recovery/death saves precede other start effects and voluntary decisions. Actual Unconscious still has its regular death saves when truly Dying. An ending save allowed below is not an Action,Reaction,death save,recharge or companion turn.
common.information: Keep world truth,actual body/action/life state,recipient-private sensory view,observer knowledge and cast-private admission/RNG records separately. The caster gains no hidden roster,save result,HP,enemy predicate,source defense or blocked-query reason. Do not publish seeds,hidden d20s or payload dice unless an exact source presentation grant applies. Existing DE4 entries retain their exact scope; Dragon damage does not acquire the Burning Hands display entry. Ordinary witness facts remain actual evidence; recognition never shares itself telepathically. No source provides a camera,omniscient map or truth-debug interface.
common.apparentCandidate: NEW P156-APPARENT-01 applies ONLY to an unrecognized apparent creature/object presented by this Mass Hallucination or Illusory Dragon. A genuinely deceived actor may declare an otherwise legally available creature/object-targeted Action,spell or ordinary attack at that apparent coordinate. Verify observable prerequisites and actual available cost/Action/components first; commit normal costs/cadence,then actual interruption windows. Before any target attack/save/effect roll,revalidate the real required target and its actual position/range/LoE. Missing/shifted ineligible body gives no target roll/effect and no special reason,identity or replacement target; costs remain. This is an expressly new paid apparent-candidate failure,not legal creature/object status for an image. It adds NO Spectral Army AC10,attack-roll/detonation permission,opportunity-attack trigger or on-hit/kill benefit. Recognized false images have no apparent-candidate permission and known invalid requests cost0. Real physical inspection/touch/movement retains its own Action/interactions,cost and geometry; actual weapon/projectile collision consequences need their own sources and stay held if absent.
common.defenses: Use actual condition/source scope. This return explicitly classifies Hall private visual remapping,Phantom private dying belief/mental Unconscious,and Anti compelled approach/retreat as mind-affecting spell components for the exact accepted Mind Blank Abjuration rule. Dragon fear is imposed emotion; its psychic packets use actual psychic immunity independently. The external Dragon sensory image is not a recipient mental rewrite and remains an apparent world image under Mind Blank. Charmed-only immunity grants no immunity to these uncharmed spells; fear-only immunity affects Dragon fear only. Broader actually applicable protections are checked before fresh establishment; existing covered components suspend with original clocks/guards. No prevented component appears after immunity ends. No new unavailable Mind Blank school access is granted.
common.lifeAndCustody: Only genuine damage changes real HP,tempHP,Wounds,Injuries,concentration or death ledgers. Apply exact ordinary/Null recipient lifecycle and original root flags; caster-paid Dragon breath roots belong to caster,not image/target. Preserve physical items,owners,custody,charges,damage,real dropped objects,spent actions and counters through recognition/suppression/ending. Real0 causes its own Unconscious,real death persists. Ending a perception effect neither heals nor resurrects nor resets a death save. No fake corpse,XP,loot,RP,kill or healing event follows illusory0 or image removal.
common.holds: All inherited source/content/access/physical/lifecycle/knowledge/runtime/human-play/balance/cosmology/release holds remain. Actual faction/hostility/creature taxonomy/identities,geometry/equipment/weapon sources and missing private information are facts to prove,not authored successes. Synthetic fixtures show conditional deterministic specifications,not actual campaign examples or an executed game. No supplied/historical programs are executed.

rules.admission: NEW one actual perceived living creature within120ft/LoE,WIS versus original DC. No inferred creature-type mental immunity; genuinely applicable mental/illusion/Unconscious defense applies. Success leaves it unaffected. Failure proposes one combined private dying tableau/perceivedHP0 plus real source-linked Unconscious. No damage,temporaryHP or real HP change. The hard-control ceiling is explicitly extended to this new ordinary-spell component: one established equivalent hard-denial component from the same original source-character against that target per encounter,shared with that source existing covered class/ordinary-spell hard-denial history. Countering,save,actual prevention or pre-loss recognition does not consume it; actual establishment does,even if an independent Unconscious cause already exists. An exhausted guard or inability to establish the required Unconscious prevents the WHOLE application; no fallback soft penalty or private fake0.
rules.trueSeeingOrder: NEW P156-PHANTOM-PRELOSS-01: after failedWIS and applicable prevention checks,but BEFORE imposing Unconscious,offer only the target a brief private visual impression of its own body failing and private apparentHP0. An actually awake target with usable sight and a genuinely active True Seeing source can personally identify that own-body false sensory tableau within60ft/path; that conclusive recognition ends the entire proposal before hard-guard expenditure. This is explicit Phantom-only pre-loss ordering,not seeing while Unconscious or blanket anti-illusion immunity. If it is already Unconscious,Blinded or otherwise lacks that usable sight,no such witness exists and pre-existing True Seeing grants no bypass. Another observer never sees the private tableau or reads target HP through True Seeing. After actual Unconscious establishes,that condition prevents usable sight; True Seeing alone does not wake it. No actual diagnosis/debug information is given to caster.
rules.actualControl: NEW actual Unconscious has the exact existing consequences: Incapacitated,unaware,cannot move/speak,drop currently held real items at actual lawful coordinates/custody,fall Prone unless actual Prone immunity,STR/DEX saves automatically fail,attacks against have advantage,hits from within5ft are critical. Apply actual advantage/disadvantage cancellation with independent Prone and other causes. Incapacity ends target concentration without a damage-CON check. Actual HP,tempHP,maxHP,Wounds,Injuries,death counters,Null and life history are unchanged by illusory0. Perceived-zero is a private view,not a second life pool. Other observers see only actual posture,breathing,items and otherwise perceivable body facts; no counterfeit death signs,corpse,medical certainty or secret HP display.
rules.escape: NEW choose the source question second escape option: any genuinely positive resolved damage received (including absorbed tempHP damage),or one actual willing ally Rouse Action within5ft with genuine perception and physical contact/communication,ends this ENTIRE Phantom application. No contested rouse check,remote word or free object interaction. Resolve the complete real damage/life/ending callbacks FIRST,then remove Phantom if any record remains. Zero/prevented damage does not end it. NEW qualifying healing alone does NOT end an independent Phantom Unconscious,even if real HP increases; healing is not the selected rouse Action and creates no extra wakeup trigger. No periodic END save is added: escape is initial resistance,pre-loss recognition,real positive damage,paid Rouse,actual removal/suppression or the finite deadline. No save-only companion bridge or new turn is needed for this spell.
rules.lifeSeparation: Real damage/healing and ordinary life processes continue. Genuine damage may reduce trueHP to0,trigger one real Wound save,Instant Death or real death failures under actual source order. Real Dying0 still takes its scheduled regular-START death saves while private/real Unconscious causes exist. Qualifying Null damage follows actual root lifecycle and still counts as positive actual damage for ending Phantom,not as fake damage. Ending Phantom corrects the private view and removes only its own Unconscious cause; genuine zeroHP Unconscious,Dead,Prone,dropped items,spent Actions,damage,Wounds and counters persist. Ordinary healing never revives Dead. A new real concentration must be separately legally cast; old concentration never returns.
rules.lifecycle: NEW retain concentration60seconds,one target and one live Phantom per caster. Suppression temporarily disables private illusion and its own Unconscious cause; a truly positiveHP living target can act normally if no other cause prevents it,but no posture/item/action/guard refund occurs. Suppression is not a permanent cure; on resumption before deadline reapply only surviving expression without new admission or hard-guard expenditure. Resumption restores the existing record rather than establishing a new condition application: do not replay its consumed one-time drop/Prone consequences or reset any guard. Ongoing Incapacity does end newly maintained concentration. This preserves the condition-overlay no-replay boundary; any independent new physical fall/drop needs its own source and is not granted by resumption. Rouse or real positive damage ends the retained record even while its expression is suppressed. Terminal target death or source ending ends the record,never reverses actual death. Source-preserved clocks and once-per-encounter history remain.

At casting choose one initial operation; each later caster Action can issue one new operation. Choose Raise, Lower or Redirect: Raise lifts a supported connected body’s local surface by at most ten feet above its recorded starting level, maintaining that finite shape while concentration permits; Lower displaces its water sideways/down into actual available volume to lower the local surface at most ten feet below the starting level; Redirect changes its flow along the chosen open path, moving it at most ten feet for that operation. completeCurrentCard.procedure:
KEEP Action,one perceived creature60feet,4d8necrotic per round and heal half. NEW reconcile Core Instantaneous with a concentration channel lasting at most60seconds, with one initial pulse during the casting Action and at most nine further pulses, never more than ten total. The initial pulse makes a ranged spell attack against the declared creature using the real casting source; hit deals4d8necrotic (ordinary attack critical applies), miss deals none. Only one original target exists; no retarget. At each future regular caster turn an Action may maintain one further pulse against that same still-existing original creature target, with perception/range60/line of effect rechecked. At most one pulse per original regular caster-turn cycle; extra turns/Actions grant none. If no maintenance Action is completed during an available future regular turn, the channel ends at that turn's END; a miss still counts as maintenance. Outside initiative an otherwise capable caster spends the equivalent whole Action at each successive six-second cycle; missed maintenance ends it. Loss of concentration, actual caster incapacity, target death, actual separation beyond60feet, loss of line of effect/perception, removal or expiry ends the channel immediately; suppression makes a pulse unavailable, consumes its scheduled opportunity and therefore causes missed-maintenance ending if it spans the entire relevant turn/cycle. No paused beam or stored future pulse exists. A hit's healing resolves after its damage/life consequences, even if that hit killed the target and thereby ended later pulses: caster receives ordinary base healing floor(actualDamageDealt/2), using this pulse's eligible terminal branches once and excluding duplicated parents, overkill and copied/replayed descendants. Do not halve nominal dice before counting actual damage or require ordinary HP loss when tempHP was truly absorbed. Damage transfer remains one root; sum its actual terminal recipients without healing separately for each. Apply genuine ordinary healing modifiers, broad prohibition, current maximum/Critical ceiling and source causal guards. Full casterHP, blocked healing or a miss stores nothing and refunds nothing. Unlike Lifedraw's expressly narrower profile, this proposal adds no living-nonconstruct/allied/helpless exclusion to the printed damage and heal clause; necrotic defenses still govern actual numbers. Damage/HP cannot be farmed from an invented summon resource pool or overkill. A subsequent paid cast begins a genuinely new channel and concentration, not a free same-channel extra pulse; all real Action/RP/Dissonance costs apply. The proposal's ten-pulse ceiling and continuous maintenance are NEW balance choices for joint review.

CURRENT HEALING-ELIGIBILITY COMPLETION: Exclude any terminal branch whose actual transfer/source flags forbid derived healing or recovery before summing the base-healing pool. The original NE5-06-B arithmetic is conditional on a genuinely permitted split, not a claim that Burden Shared or Life Linked allows it. The two supplied source-qualified vectors show their actual narrower results and retain the original abstract scenario unchanged. Neither vector changes the separate pending broad donor predicate for this spell.

CURRENT TARGET-CONTINUITY COMPLETION — Enervation only: "Still-existing original creature" is the target identity/lifecycle predicate, not a new living-anatomy or nonconstruct restriction. A continuing active creature classified as nonliving is not excluded solely by that classification. Its actual defenses, damage/source eligibility and no-resource/no-recovery flags still apply to each packet and any healing funding. A corpse, removed body, ended summon or destroyed entity that no longer qualifies as a creature cannot supply a maintained target. A same identity at 0 HP is tested under its actual continuing-creature/Disabled/death state, not assumed dead or alive from the HP number. The attack that actually ends the target finishes its own causal damage and source-qualified healing before future channel opportunities are canceled. This completion does not import Leeching Plague's hostile-living-nonconstruct donor filter, provide healing to a dead caster, or grant repair, resurrection, resource farming or an exception to another source's exclusion flags.

previousSharedProposalUnchanged.damageAndHealing: Use reviewed typed defenses, minimum-HP prevention, temporary HP, Wounds, Instant Death, dying/Stable, actual death and eligible immediate survival responses. A BA selects exactly one body and one ordinary Move plus its single profiled Action or ordinary permitted basic Action, executed only in the owner's existing attached phase after the whole owner turn. Every other capable body has only defensive Move and Dodge in that phase. No independent initiative, Reaction, BA, multiattack, spellcasting, Help engine, tool proficiency, resource pool or summon power exists. Committed orders retain reviewed validity rules. An actual resurrection source must meet its reviewed reconstruction requirements for a consumed body; this packet grants none. Created summons leave no corpse/loot. Source-qualified maximum-HP modifiers require genuine access and actual spell provenance; a Wizard spell creation can qualify for its actual Conjuration modifier, never a generic borrowed Wizard level. previousSharedProposalUnchanged.zombieProfile: NEW shared Flood/Danse zombie animation profile: actual Small or Medium eligible body, type Undead; baseAC10, baseHP20, walk20feet only with its original functional walking supports; STR12, DEX6, CON14, INT3, WIS6, CHA3. completeSharedRules.P20-CASTING-01: Reuse actual class-access/repertoire, paid costs, component, concentration and Dissonance/Refrain procedures from the exact registry. None of these drafts grants a new class row, rank, upcast or resource maximum. A continuous field, stored rider or command does not itself cast again. completeSharedRules.P20-DIGITAL-GEOMETRY-01: NEW bounded clarification for these 20 proposals: measure the actual occupied body against the continuous authored volume/surface, with actual cover/line of effect. Five-foot lengths remain real lengths, not a rounding of positions onto tabletop squares. Source-authored five-foot destructible/fuel partitions remain fixed object identities; changing path sampling, zoom or visual mesh subdivision cannot create more targets, HP or exposure. Evaluate a genuine entry at the first boundary crossing/contact, resolve it once before continuing the same trajectory, and preserve actual remaining movement. Teleport crosses no intermediate path; an arrival can trigger only a source explicitly authorizing arrival. Snapshot simultaneous recipients once before their consequences; destroyed cover creates no second wave.
completeSharedRules.P20-CLOCKS-01: NEW explicit cohort bindings: absolute field deadlines are resolution+60 seconds where the procedure states one minute; expiry wins at equality. Source-owned pulses at resolution and +6 through +54 do not require a caster turn or grant a creature turn. A finite target/source marker schedule records its original regular markers at creation under accepted time ordering; reorder, extra turns and departure preserve the original virtual schedule, six seconds apart. Explicit future-turn endpoints exclude an in-progress turn/phase; an ending save expressly including current END keeps that exception. At START, apply accepted expiry/recovery/death-save ordering before periodic damage. At END, due damage/eligible ending saves precede that source endpoint cleanup, except a card explicitly expires before its redundant last save. Suppression consumes a due scheduled opportunity with no damage or catch-up. Ended creature identities have no recipient; administrative deadline bookkeeping never resurrects one.
completeSharedRules.P20-ATTACHED-PHASE-01: NEW source-specific bridge for the target-clock proposals in this cohort, not a general companion turn: an owner-attached recipient uses the original owner regular attached-phase beginning/end only for the stated spell packet or ending save. A future phase excludes one already underway. If no such real phase exists, retain a six-second spell-only checkpoint and finite original endpoint. This checkpoint supplies only a due packet/save or expiry that the spell actually grants; it supplies no Action, movement, Bonus Action, Reaction refresh, recharge, or ordinary death save. Source-required real Action/command maintenance cannot execute at an administrative checkpoint. Root identity, prior spent exposures, endpoint and finite tick count survive controller or schedule changes.
completeSharedRules.P20-FAMILY-EXPOSURE-01: NEW per-source anti-duplication applies only where the individual procedure names a family cap: record target identity, named spell family, explicit category and numbered round. Different owners/casts share that named ledger; distinct spell names and explicitly separate Wall of Fire categories do not merge. Outside initiative use the scene continuing six-second exposure cycle, fixed before the relevant exposure. Preserve its spent state through a transition to the current combat round until that mapped interval ends; never refresh just by changing timing mode. Immunity/save/prevention after actual admission still consumes the exposure; wholly suppressed or geometrically ineligible sources cannot claim it. Simultaneous eligible sources use established application order then stable identity. Immolation instead uses the already accepted ongoing-fire arbitration at each identical target marker.
completeSharedRules.P20-DAMAGE-FUNDING-01: Reuse actual typed defenses, temporary HP, HP floors, Wounds, concentration, death/Null life order and one original recipient event. No inferred damage amount from structural failure or overkill. ActualDamageDealt remains real tempHP absorption plus normal HP loss. Healing/funding is a separate consumer: first exclude any terminal branch whose actual transfer/source flag forbids derived healing or recovery, then apply the spell-specific donor predicate, sum eligible branches once and floor the half once. Never count a split parent again. Burden Shared and Life Linked restrictions remain operative; a numeric branch amount alone is not funding permission. Preserve the distinct pending Leeching Plague donor exclusions and Enervation wider proposal for explicit Director disposition.
completeSharedRules.P20-RNG-INFORMATION-01: Authored dice are engine RNG. Original component identity, draw method, save factor and cached ordinal value remain private engine state unless an actual separately accepted presentation policy grants the exact disclosure. This candidate grants no new public dice viewer, hidden-target list, successful-save feedback, enemy-identity scan or Fate eligibility. Shared damage dice do not merge recipient roots. The accepted exact DE4 five-entry presentation policy applies only where its actual source predicates pass; it does not automatically disclose any private periodic, delayed, penalty or random-selection operation in this cohort. An actual qualifying OVERT-ATTACK d20 can use that entry without exposing a hidden Synaptic Static d6, hidden modifier cause or later damage pool. No sixth presentation entry is proposed here. No RNG seed or future draw is exposed. If a source has no admitted recipient and no explicit source-authored event-generation rule, do not invent a damage event merely to publish a roll.
completeSharedRules.P20-ROOT-01: Every damage source uses its explicit pending per-source mapping in damageRootProposals. These are NEW decisions requiring concurrence; accepted Forbiddance/Chain Arc/Skybrand and lower nightmare rules do not silently generalize. Root creation alone spends no Action, deals no damage, triggers no Wound, generates no material, and grants no hidden information. Pure transfer retains flags; an attached component can retain an old flag while a genuinely new operated attack creates its own root. Physical fire and Sonic debris mappings are bounded to the exact finite proposed outputs.
completeSharedRules.P20-SUPPRESSION-01: Reuse the exact actual suppressor/removal source. Lesser Antimagic, rank limits and source versus expression tests keep their accepted scope. AC6 Globe is not general antimagic: its fixed boundary blocks only its actual incoming rank-0–5 source cases, does not ban all internal casting, and does not erase an already attached buff merely because a creature enters. A fixed external ongoing field and a target-attached rider have different origin facts. A spell object is not a creature; physical Inferno fuel/rubble after actual creation is not a sustained magical field. No suppression pauses a deadline or restores a destroyed body, cleared crystal patch, spent shot or old command.

None of these drafts grants a new class row, rank, upcast or resource maximum. A continuous field, stored rider or command does not itself cast again. completeSharedRules.P20-DIGITAL-GEOMETRY-01: NEW bounded clarification for these 20 proposals: measure the actual occupied body against the continuous authored volume/surface, with actual cover/line of effect. Five-foot lengths remain real lengths, not a rounding of positions onto tabletop squares. Source-authored five-foot destructible/fuel partitions remain fixed object identities; changing path sampling, zoom or visual mesh subdivision cannot create more targets, HP or exposure. Evaluate a genuine entry at the first boundary crossing/contact, resolve it once before continuing the same trajectory, and preserve actual remaining movement. Teleport crosses no intermediate path; an arrival can trigger only a source explicitly authorizing arrival. Snapshot simultaneous recipients once before their consequences; destroyed cover creates no second wave.
completeSharedRules.P20-CLOCKS-01: NEW explicit cohort bindings: absolute field deadlines are resolution+60 seconds where the procedure states one minute; expiry wins at equality. Source-owned pulses at resolution and +6 through +54 do not require a caster turn or grant a creature turn. A finite target/source marker schedule records its original regular markers at creation under accepted time ordering; reorder, extra turns and departure preserve the original virtual schedule, six seconds apart. Explicit future-turn endpoints exclude an in-progress turn/phase; an ending save expressly including current END keeps that exception. At START, apply accepted expiry/recovery/death-save ordering before periodic damage. At END, due damage/eligible ending saves precede that source endpoint cleanup, except a card explicitly expires before its redundant last save. Suppression consumes a due scheduled opportunity with no damage or catch-up. Ended creature identities have no recipient; administrative deadline bookkeeping never resurrects one.
completeSharedRules.P20-ATTACHED-PHASE-01: NEW source-specific bridge for the target-clock proposals in this cohort, not a general companion turn: an owner-attached recipient uses the original owner regular attached-phase beginning/end only for the stated spell packet or ending save. A future phase excludes one already underway. If no such real phase exists, retain a six-second spell-only checkpoint and finite original endpoint. Source-required real Action/command maintenance cannot execute at an administrative checkpoint. Root identity, prior spent exposures, endpoint and finite tick count survive controller or schedule changes.
completeSharedRules.P20-FAMILY-EXPOSURE-01: NEW per-source anti-duplication applies only where the individual procedure names a family cap: record target identity, named spell family, explicit category and numbered round. Different owners/casts share that named ledger; distinct spell names and explicitly separate Wall of Fire categories do not merge. Outside initiative use the scene continuing six-second exposure cycle, fixed before the relevant exposure. Preserve its spent state through a transition to the current combat round until that mapped interval ends; never refresh just by changing timing mode. completeSharedRules.P20-RNG-INFORMATION-01: Authored dice are engine RNG.
